description: This file defines the 'Or' class, which implements a logical disjunction operator ('OR') for combining multiple LogicCriteria objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes a basic toString method and comments explaining its purpose and usage examples.

classes.name: Or
classes.description: Represents a logical 'OR' operator used to combine multiple LogicCriteria objects in a query within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string 'OR' to represent the disjunction operator when the object is converted to a string.
